relations.zotero_refs: Author reported for instance (ID:4626) in [8H6M69W4], No. 15556: dge bshes po to ba'i slob ma rnal 'byor pa shes rab rdo rje.
relations.tei_refs: ex21032024-09-0412-46-27. In the colophon, the author refers to himself as "bdag." A note glosses "shag kya'i dge slong prad nya pad+zra" (Prajñāvajra, Tib. shes rab rdo rje). A note to this note, written by another hand, suggests that this could be Po to ba's student rNal 'byor pa shes rab rdo rje.
relations.support_notes: Some elements in the text indicate that the author is more likely a disciple of rNal 'byor pa shes rab rdo rje.

comments:
The author names in the text "dge bshes ston pa" (ID:3827), "jo bo" (ID:3745) ex021032025-12-0316-55-50, and "dge bshes pu to ba" (ID:3829), whose view is opposed to that of "dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa" ex021032025-12-0316-33-34 . 
He refers several times to the views of unidentified scholars and twice to "Tibetan teachers" (bod ston pa) ex021032025-12-0316-40-29, ex021032025-12-0316-48-00 .
